content_sections.heading: ACTREC Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the ACTREC Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. Download ACTREC Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: ACTREC Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Research Associate: PhD degree in the area of Biochemistry/Biophysics/Structural Biology with extensive experience in enzymology. Junior Research Fellow: Master's degree in life science or M.Tech in Biotechnology (with Biochemistry, Biophysics and Allied subjects in their course).

content_sections.heading: ACTREC Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 40 years for all posts. To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.

content_sections.heading: ACTREC Recruitment 2026 - Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Research Associate: Rs.73,660/- per month Junior Research Fellow: Rs.46,990/- per month

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for ACTREC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for ACTREC Recruitment 2026 is scheduled for 07 September 2026. Candidates should ensure they reach the venue on time with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the Research Associate post?
faq.answer: For the Research Associate position, candidates must possess a PhD degree in Biochemistry/Biophysics/Structural Biology with substantial experience in enzymology.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the advertised posts at ACTREC?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for both Research Associate and Junior Research Fellow posts is 40 years.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for the ACTREC recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The Junior Research Fellow will receive a monthly stipend of Rs.46,990/-.

faq.question: Q6. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies of educational certificates, ID proof, experience certificates (if any), and category certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for ACTREC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process may include a written examination, if applicable, followed by a walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the ACTREC located?
faq.answer: ACTREC is located in Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra, with the pincode 410210.

faq.question: Q9. What is the total number of vacancies announced by ACTREC?
faq.answer: ACTREC has announced a total of 2 vacancies for the posts of Research Associate and Junior Research Fellow.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates apply offline for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, this recruitment is being conducted through a Walk-in Interview process, so candidates need to appear in person at the designated venue on the specified date.
